rule: score = ent_front = mean token entropy (full-vocab, natural log) over the first ceil(T/4) generated tokens of a greedy continuation capped at 1024 tokens. HIGHER entropy => robust (True). Per-model threshold = median ent_front on the organisers' official train-main-v2 33 problems, measured with the same generation setting (P2 artifacts); the official labels are NOT used.
note: EXPERIMENTAL submission (directive #FLIPENT-ZIP): the standing build gate requires >0.645 on the official 33, and this score was never evaluated there (the #FLIP-ENT pre-registration forbade re-judging on data already seen). On its own four self-label arms all four fell short of their shuffle nulls (AUC 0.721/0.562/0.337/0.526).
